dialogue.mcacapitals_petition_menu: What do you petition the sovereign for?
dialogue.mcacapitals_petition_menu.mcaca: Petition for Commander of the Royal Army
dialogue.mcacapitals_petition_noble_menu: What noble dignity do you seek?
dialogue.mcacapitals_chat_capital_topic_: There is never a true quiet day in a capital. Even silence here feels watchful.
People speak more carefully in a capital. Words tend to travel farther than footsteps.
A capital draws ambition the way lanterns draw moths.
Once a village becomes a capital, every little dispute starts sounding like state business.
A crown changes more than the ruler. It changes the whole mood of a place.
People stand a little straighter in a capital, as though history might be watching.
A capital is never short on rumours. Truth is the harder thing to come by.
Life in a capital feels busier, even when no one can quite say why.
Even celebration feels more political in a capital.
There is always the sense in a capital that someone, somewhere, is waiting for their moment.
dialogue.mcacapitals_chat_capital_fail_0: This is not the best moment for idle talk. A capital keeps its people busy.
Another time. There is always too much happening in a capital for peace to last long.
Not now. Even small talk can feel like business in a capital.
Forgive me, but there are too many ears in a capital for careless words.
Perhaps later. People watch one another more closely in a capital.
Best not now. Capitals have a way of turning quiet moments into public ones.
